children: expects full-year revenue growth and net interest margin expansion toward the lower end of the ranges the company provided in its summer update, management said during its Q3 earnings call.
The previous update saw 2026 revenue growth of 17.5%-18.5% and NIM expansion into the 3.00%-3.10% range.

But the company also expects expenses to come in at the lower end of the prior range of 9.5%-10.5%. All told, the company expects mid-teens EPS growth through the cycle, Chief Financial Officer Mike Verdeschi said.
expects to deliver ~800 basis points of operating leverage, he said.
For Q4 2026, Verdeschi expects about 25 basis points NIM expansion from the year-ago quarter. Lending balances are exceeding its securities portfolio, which is supportive of NIM, he said.
stock fell 2.6% in Thursday midday trading.
